type.quote: The State Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners, hereinafter called the Board of Examiners, consists of: (1) Nine physicians licensed in accordance with this chapter; (2) One physician assistant licensed in accordance with chapter 36-4A; (3) One emergency medical services personnel

umbrella_agency.quote: The Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners shall continue within the Department of Health, and shall retain all its prescribed functions, including administrative functions.

age_minimum.quote: The Board of Examiners shall grant a license to any applicant who gives satisfactory proof of being at least eighteen years of age

moral_character_required.quote: The Board of Examiners shall grant a license to any applicant who gives satisfactory proof of being at least eighteen years of age and who is of good moral character

exams.name: Written examination (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Applicant must attain at least 75% correct answers; eligible for maximum 2 subsequent examinations after initial failure; must pass all parts within 7 years (10 years for dual MD-PhD). Board may waive 7-year requirement for ABMS board-certified applicants.
exams.jurisdiction: National (USMLE referenced in compact; state board administers or designates)
exams.quote: Any applicant failing on such examination is eligible for a maximum of two subsequent examinations upon payment of the required fee

interval_years.quote: The renewal shall be issued by the secretary upon payment of a biennial fee set by the board

required.quote: Physicians shall comply with all continuing professional development or continuing medical education requirements for renewal of a license issued by a member state.

available.quote: The Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners may, without examination, issue a license to any applicant holding a currently valid license or certificate issued to the applicant by the examining board of the District of Columbia, any state or territory of the United States, the National Board of Medical Examiners, the National Board of Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, or any province of Canada, if the legal requirements of the examining board at the time it issued the license or certificate were not less than those of this state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a currently valid license from another state, territory, DC, national board, or Canadian province with requirements not less than South Dakota's at the time issued; board may require oral or written examination and personal appearance; fee not to exceed $400.
requirements.quote: the board may require the applicant to successfully pass either an oral or written examination and personally appear before the board, a member of the board, or its staff
